exploration_routes.name: Main Nahi Bol Rahi
exploration_routes.reader_mirror: The partner who stays angry but still checks food, water, and comfort.
exploration_routes.emotional_obstacle: A tiny fight creates silence, but the care habit refuses to stop.
exploration_routes.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's gussa is expressive, turned away, and still full of practical care.
exploration_routes.zuv_active_role: Zuv answers her care with his own quiet care by keeping her glass too.
exploration_routes.proof_engine: Food reminder, water reminder, glass placement, turned-away body language.
exploration_routes.emotional_reversal: The silence starts as anger and turns into proof that care survives the fight.
exploration_routes.distribution_reason: Viewers can tag the partner who says they are not talking but still cares.

stage_scene_gate.action: Aachu turns away but keeps giving care instructions.
stage_scene_gate.reaction: Zuv listens and responds by placing her glass too.
stage_scene_gate.eye_line_or_attention: Aachu avoids eye contact; Zuv watches the care action, not just the anger.
stage_scene_gate.hands_or_object_movement: Plate, water, and glass move across the scene.
stage_scene_gate.silence_or_pause: The silence is visible in body distance and turned-away posture.
stage_scene_gate.consequence: The fight stays tiny because care keeps moving.

emotional_machine: tiny fight -> silence -> care instructions leak out -> Zuv reciprocates with one quiet care action -> gussa and care coexist
proof_engine: Food reminder, water reminder, glass placement, body distance, turned-away face.
reader_mirror: This is us when one person is angry but still taking care.
distribution_reason: A viewer can send it to the partner who says they are not talking but still asks if you ate.

human_story_setup.emotional_obstacle: A tiny fight creates silence, but care is too habitual to stop.
human_story_setup.aachu_role: She brings expressive gussa and practical care in the same breath.
human_story_setup.zuv_role: He notices the care underneath the gussa and answers with quiet reciprocal care.
human_story_setup.proof_engine: Khana, paani, and her glass become visible receipts.
human_story_setup.emotional_reversal: Anger is not the absence of love; the instructions prove care is still there.

success_definition.audience_success: Partner tags and 'this is us' comments from people who fight softly but care practically.
success_definition.creative_success: A staged story sequence with concrete receipts and no quote-card dependence.
success_definition.brand_success: Ownable warm desi relationship IP: gussa plus care as a recurring behavior.
success_definition.production_success: Native 4:5 and 9:16 final illustrations with identity/style QA.

stage_scene_gate.action: Aachu says she is not talking, then gives care instructions.
stage_scene_gate.reaction: Zuv accepts the contradiction and keeps her glass too.
stage_scene_gate.eye_line_or_attention: Avoided eye contact turns into quiet attention on the care objects.
stage_scene_gate.hands_or_object_movement: Plate, water, glass, and blanket remain physical proof beats.
stage_scene_gate.silence_or_pause: The silence is comic, not cruel.
stage_scene_gate.consequence: Both remain in the tiny fight, but care continues.
stage_scene_gate.reversal_or_payoff: The fight becomes a proof of their care language.

process_influences.title: Banter To Belonging
process_influences.reason: The concept uses a desi phrase and turns banter/gussa into belonging.
